name: Blade Song
detailed_description:
At the dawn of the Daning Dynasty, with the chaos of war just subsided, the new emperor issued the "Martial Prohibition Edict," wielding the might of the Mysterious Iron Guards to suppress the martial world, aiming to forge a "World Without Martial Arts." The court implemented benevolent policies to stabilize the people, earning their deep loyalty, yet viewed the martial world as a source of disorder, vowing to control or eradicate it. In the jianghu, the Heavenly Sword Fragment resurfaced, containing the "Nine Forms of the Heavenly Sword" and a forbidden power capable of overturning the heavens, drawing the covetous eyes of all factions. The Blood Blade Sect emerged in response, gathering valiant heroes unwilling to see the martial world wither, pledging to protect their legacy through fierce means and resist the court's oppression.

Chu Changhe, an ordinary young man with a heart full of chivalrous ideals, finds himself swept into a deadly struggle among the Mysterious Iron Guards, the martial world, and the Blood Blade Sect.

Turn - Based Combat

In this martial arts JRPG, turn - based combat serves as the core stage for players to experience the disputes in the martial arts world.

Diverse Martial Arts, Build Your Martial Arts System

Hundreds of martial arts secrets with different styles are included in the game, Players can obtain martial arts secrets by completing jianghu adventures, challenging martial arts masters, exploring hidden ancient ruins and other ways. Some peerless martial arts also have special trigger conditions and combo mechanisms.
